# qgiscraft (full)

QGIS-class GIS in pure Rust: clean-room 1:1 clone shell for QGIS muscle
memory (menus, docks, canvas, shortcuts), modern core, CLI + MCP first.
No QGIS code inside; QGIS 3.44 LTR is the black-box oracle (plan/qgis/).

## Tracks

- Track A (native, working): eframe/egui app + CLI + MCP stdio server.
  Zero ports, in-process core calls, SQLite project file (`qgiscraft.db`).
- Track B (reserved): ports 11253/11254 claimed for a future webapp.

## Architecture

L1 `qgiscraft-core`: geo types, `Command::dispatch` (9 ids), Photon/Overpass
clients (opt-in live), slippy tile math + cached fetch, ear-clip triangulation.
L2 `qgiscraft-mcp`: CLI-first binary + MCP server (MCP 2024-11-05, hand-rolled
line-delimited JSON-RPC, stdout pure). Owns SQLite persistence.
L3 `qgiscraft`: egui shell, owns the DB file, Web Mercator canvas, XYZ
tiles (2 fetches/frame, disk cache), `--smoke` headless BMP preview.
Store `qgiscraft-store`: rusqlite/bundled, layers + features(+geom_json).

## Tools (MCP + CLI)

status, project.status, layer.add, layer.list, layer.remove,
geocode.search (demo/live), overpass.query (builder/dry-run/live/ingest),
features.list, export.png (typed unsupported). See docs/TOOLS.md.

## Config (env only)

QGISCRAFT_DB (default ./qgiscraft.db), QGISCRAFT_TILES_URL,
QGISCRAFT_PHOTON_URL, QGISCRAFT_OVERPASS_URL. Shown live in Settings menu.

## Gates (AGENTS.md normative)

cargo fmt --check; clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D
warnings (deny unwrap/expect/panic/todo/unimplemented); cargo test
--workspace (56 tests, offline, hermetic temp DBs); xtask ci/layers/parity.
New capability = Command + test + MCP tool + CLI flag + menu entry.
